finding_info.title: Defender for Endpoint - Suspicious 'Bovter' backdoor was prevented
finding_info.desc: Malicious activity matching the PowerShell-based Bovter backdoor family was detected by Microsoft Defender Antivirus on ws-fin-042.contoso.corp. A malicious LNK shortcut spawned cmd.exe which launched powershell.exe with an obfuscated, base64-encoded command line attempting to establish a reverse TCP connection to 195.201.59.127:4443. AMSI detected the script content and Defender Antivirus quarantined the process. MITRE ATT&CK: T1059.001 (PowerShell), T1027 (Obfuscated Files or Information), T1140 (Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information).
